card_comparison: Twenty-four explicit Problem x.y headings are represented by source-local cards; Problem 8.7 reuses canonical card E-TJ3WM because it asks exactly for the holomorphic automorphisms of C.
transcription_corrections: Problem 1.1 describes an (n+1)-by-(n+1) matrix but calls the standard basis vectors n-by-1; the card uses the dimension forced by the displayed construction.
Problem 1.2 inconsistently writes f for p and z for z_0 in the maximum/integral formulas; the card uses the polynomial and center defined by the problem.
Problem 3.5's first clause is normalized to existence of a zero in the open unit disc, as forced by its Maximum Modulus hint and the following Rouché clause.
Problem 4.2 omits the center value in the phrase 'disc with center and radius pi/2'; the card spells out the intended disc centered at 0 and the Taylor partial sums of cosine.
Problems 5.3 and 5.6 lose overlines on Omega in the machine extraction; the public text rendering of the same source confirms compactness/continuity on the closure.
Problem 9.1 drops the condition det != 0; the surrounding discussion that the determinant zero set has empty interior forces the statement that invertible matrices are dense.
Problem 9.4 renders the final p with a stray dot; the same-source public text confirms the intended polynomial p.
